title: Melencolia I
theme: melancholy, knowledge, human limit, creative despair

interpretations.text: Dürer's Melencolia I personifies melancholy as a winged, seated genius surrounded by instruments of geometry, craft, and measurement that lie unused. It is a meditation on the limits of human intellect and the creative mind stalled between aspiration and incompleteness. The magic square and geometric solids suggest the Renaissance faith in order; the idle tools suggest that knowledge alone does not grant peace. Melancholy here is not mere sadness but the weight of thinking too far.
Heavy, nocturnal, intellectually restless. Suited to burnout, perfectionism, the ache of unfinished work, and the bittersweet dignity of deep thought.
Engraving dense with symbols: putto, sleeping dog, ladder, sphere, polyhedron, bat bearing the title. Angular composition; seated figure dominates the left-center.
